description: Get official macro figures for a country for research, market sizing or country-risk work. Returns World Bank World Development Indicators for up to 5 of ~217 economies: GDP, GDP per capita, real growth, CPI inflation, unemployment, population, government debt, trade, FDI or any WDI code, latest years with the year of each value. Use when a figure must be citable to an official source. $0.005 per call, USDC on Base (x402).

countries.description: Comma list of ISO2/ISO3 codes, up to 5 (e.g. DE,DK,USA)

indicators.description: Comma list of short names (gdp, gdp_per_capita, gdp_growth, inflation, unemployment, population, debt, current_account, exports, fdi, interest_rate) or WDI codes; default core set

payment_signature.description: x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value. Omit to receive payment requirements.

name: macro_indicators
